placements.why: Establishes an organizational process category for formal release gates and deployment controls prompted by unsigned artifact incidents.
placements.title: Formal Deployment Verification and Quality Gates
placements.frame: What formal gates and verification controls govern releases before deployment to staging and production?

placements.title: Mandatory Signed Manifest Verification for Deployment Releases
placements.frame: Why must all deployments carry signed release manifests and who holds operational ownership of the gate?
placements.why: Places the specific policy requiring signed release manifests across staging and production under Quinton Fairweather's ownership to prevent unsigned artifacts from shipping.
